verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so generating SSH key pairs is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions ssh-keygen, SSH keys, or SSH at all. The listed ios_system commands (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex) and the pkg packages (zip, xz, ffmpeg) do not include SSH key tooling, so there is no documented support.
